label: ide_wishlist
note: features mish wants for the ide. cali pulls from this during idle heartbeats, picks one, builds it, deploys, moves it to 'done'. new entries: add to 'pending' with {title, description, priority (1-5), notes?}.

pending.title: scratch iframe / sandbox preview
pending.description: test an ide edit in a sandboxed iframe before deploying to the real Downloads/cali-ide.html. cali writes to a scratch path, iframe loads it, mish approves, then deploy.

pending.title: hot-patch mode (no full reload)
pending.description: for small css/js tweaks, inject a <style> or eval snippet without full window.location.reload(). reload kills the chat state, hot-patch preserves it.
pending.notes: expose via <cursor:hotpatch css="..."> and <cursor:hotpatch js="..."> markers.

pending.title: auto-checkpoint before deploy
pending.description: wrap the deploy flow so every push to Downloads/cali-ide.html is preceded by an auto git commit. one command instead of two, and a safe rollback point is always fresh.

pending.title: mobile version for xiaomi
pending.description: responsive layout, bigger touch targets, chat-focused. no sidebar tree stuff. cursor still shows. same bridge, same --resume — mish just uses his phone.
pending.notes: mish said 'we'll see' — hold until he confirms.

pending.title: og rich url previews inline in chat
pending.description: when mish pastes a link in chat, fetch og tags via bridge and render an inline preview card (title + description + image). same when cali pastes a link back.

pending.title: drag-drop image analysis + thumbnail preview
pending.description: drag any image onto the chat area → uploads as pending attachment with proper thumbnail. dedicated 'analyze' button that primes cali with image + a describe-what-you-see prefix.

pending.title: standalone heartbeat (windows scheduled task)
pending.description: heartbeat that fires even when the ide tab is closed. windows scheduled task that runs the same tick logic via claude-p directly, no browser needed.

done.title: dom inspector
done.description: titlebar 🔍 inspect pill toggles. shift+click any element → popover with tag#id.class meta + full css selector + copy button. hover shows accent-bright dashed outline. escape exits. selector prefers id (breaks chain early), else tag + top-2 classes + :nth-child. depth cap 6.

done.title: cursor idle breath
done.description: cursor breathes on a sine wave even when idle. rise/fall ±5px, sway ±1.8px, ~4.2s period.

done.title: follow node breathes
done.description: during <cursor:follow>, the node offset from mish modulates on a sine wave ±18px along the mish→node vector. reads as a chest rising and falling around the fixed spot.

done.title: <cursor:reload> marker
done.description: hot-reload the ide tab from a cali marker. 500ms delay for pending writes.

done.title: ide error mirror
done.description: window.onerror + unhandledrejection append to ide_errors.jsonl on his machine. cali reads the tail after every reload to catch broken edits.
